name: Runner Extras - XmlPort Precompiled Dep Metadata
brief: Proves an xmlport living in a precompiled dependency gets an NCLMetaXmlPort built for it, instead of NavMetadataNotFoundException from inside the xmlport's own constructor (#3510).
description: Regression test for #3510. The dependency 'XPD Precompiled XmlPort Dep' (declared below, resolved from the committed .alpackages/*.app symbol package, loaded from the committed .deps-bin/*.dll — DependencyLoader's Tier-1 precompiled-DLL path) ships xmlport 61602 as PURE COMPILED CODE, with no AL source the runner ever parses. BuildNCLMetaXmlPort's existence check read _parsedXmlPorts — the AL-SOURCE parser's dictionary — so it returned null for every xmlport the runner did not itself compile from source, before entering its try block. That null reached NCLMetadata_GetMetaApplicationObjectByType and surfaced as NavMetadataNotFoundException from inside NavXmlPort.BeginInitialization, which is not an AL-catchable error and aborts the whole test. Measured on BC 28.1.49838.53910 against a real Microsoft Base Application: 44 of 44 precompiled xmlports failed this way — the whole population, not the six ids the issue happened to observe.
